Can true horror really make it on Broadway? A stage version of 'Paranormal Activity' hopes so

Movie producer Jason Blum, known for revolutionizing horror films, praises a stage adaptation of his “Paranormal Activity” franchise. After attending 25 horror plays, he found most of them unconvincing until this one. The play, which has toured several cities and is now on Broadway, tells the story of a couple facing strange occurrences in their new home. Despite lacking film effects, it manages to scare audiences with simple techniques such as flickering TVs and moving shadows. Blum credits the creative team with successfully bringing true horror to the stage. He believes the play's grounded approach and minimal effects enhance its impact.
